# Master standard prerequisite

- [ ] Read and apply [WEBSITE-MASTER-STANDARD.md](../WEBSITE-MASTER-STANDARD.md)
- [ ] **Actually render and visually inspect every primary page** at ~360px, ~768px and ~1440px (code review alone is insufficient)
- [ ] Include labeled screenshots/preview evidence of mobile, tablet and desktop inspection
- [ ] Re-check after fixing visual defects; record visual status PASS / FAIL / NOT VERIFIED
- [ ] If visual inspection unavailable, mark NOT READY FOR APPROVAL

# Website change / demo review

## Scope
- Business / prospect:
- Pages and intended primary visitor action:
- Demo or production:
- Verified source of business facts and licensed images:

## Mandatory standards
- [ ] Read `AGENTS.md`
- [ ] Read `docs/WEBSITE-NORTH-STAR-QC.md`
- [ ] Read `WEBSITE-QC-STANDARD.md`

## Four acceptance gates
- [ ] **Business Fit:** business-specific copy, verified claims, relevant imagery, no invented reviews or client facts
- [ ] **Conversion:** correct audience, clear early CTA, usable next step
- [ ] **Technical:** links/CTAs/images/forms checked; responsive phone/tablet/desktop; accessibility/performance basics
- [ ] **Premium Polish:** consistent design language, no missing or repetitive imagery, no generic/unfinished sections

## Whole-site QC and evidence
- [ ] Reviewed homepage and all changed/related pages together (not just individually)
- [ ] Checked pricing, hours, identity, service area and all contact details against verified facts
- [ ] Checked mobile layouts, image crops and navigation
- [ ] Click-tested key links, CTAs and forms (demo-only forms clearly marked)
- [ ] No North Star stop-ship failure remains

Screenshots/preview links and checks performed:

### Final gate status
Business Fit: PASS / FAIL / NOT VERIFIED

Conversion: PASS / FAIL / NOT VERIFIED

Technical: PASS / FAIL / NOT VERIFIED

Visual Polish: PASS / FAIL / NOT VERIFIED

Whole-site consistency: PASS / FAIL / NOT VERIFIED

**Do not represent work as production-ready if any gate is FAIL or NOT VERIFIED.** Document unresolved issues explicitly.
